title: Joint Petition of the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority and the Boston and Maine Corporation, that D.P.U. Order 18747, dated September 27, 1976, be amended by striking out the provisions requiring a crossing tender be on duty during certain hours of the day to operate the semi-tender be on duty during certain hours of the day to operate the semi-automatic features of the existing automatic highway crossing protection presently installed at the Cabot Street highway rail grade crossing in the City of Beverly, Massachusetts.
